_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Aircraft Electrical Interface Control Drawing (EICD)
summary: The EICD is a signature controlled drawing set detailing the aircraft/nuclear weapon interface and associated electrical systems, containing engineering data extracted from contractor documentation to complete a composite interface drawing.
use_relationship:
The EICD is a signature controlled drawing set detailing the aircraft/nuclear weapon interface and associated electrical systems. The Final Design Approval Report (FDAR) is part of the EICD and like the FDAR, the EICD must contain information extracted from the contractor documentation in order to complete a composite drawing reflecting the basic electrical interface features.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparations instructions for data resulting from the work task described by the following documents: MIL-STD-1822, Nuclear Compatibility Certification of Nuclear Weapon Systems, Subsystems and Support Equipment, Specification Standard No. SYS 1001 AMAC POG System 1 Basic Interface Specification, and Specification Standard No. SYS 2001 AMAC POG System 2 Basic Interface Specification.
(Copies of MIL-STD-1822 are available online at https://assist.dla.mil/quicksearch/ or from the Standardization Document Order Desk, 700 Robbins Ave., Bldg 4D, Philadelphia PA 19111-5094 and copies of the AMAC POG System Specifications are available from the AFNWC/NCSS, 8601 Frost Ave SE, Building 20203, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117-5624.)
b. This DID is related to DI-NUOR-81408, Aircraft Monitor and Control (AMAC) Preliminary Design Report (PDR) and Final Design Approval Report (FDAR) and DI-NUOR-81409, Certification Requirements Plan (CRP).
(Copies of the DIDs are available online at https://assist.dla.mil/quicksearch/ or from the Standardization Document Order Desk, 700 Robbins Ave., Bldg 4D, Philadelphia PA 19111-5094.)
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions, shall be as specified in the solicitation or contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The EICD shall provide detail of the electrical power and logical signal interfaces associated with the aircraft electrical systems used to monitor and control the aircraft/nuclear weapon interfaces on the aircraft. This includes the interfaces from the operator's cockpit control and display devices, to the connector that physically connects the nuclear weapon to the aircraft. The sequence of displays, legends, and controls is needed to control the Aircraft Monitor and Control (AMAC) and release functions as well as the status from the weapons.

children.title: The EICD shall provide engineering data and descriptions that define:
The general system information shall include
children.content: EICD introduction and index, abbreviations, acronyms, aircraft monitor and control and delivery system block diagrams, system definition and overview, interface table describing weapons and training devices and test sets, nuclear configuration table identifying hardware and its location and panel arrangement. The avionics system logical signal interfaces throughout the avionics system components as they relate to monitoring and controlling of logic signals for nuclear weapons and their delivery systems.

children.title: The physical interfaces showing wire identification
children.content: wire gauges, wire lengths, connector pin identification, bulkhead and splice locations.

children.title: The avionics system electrical interfaces for controlling
children.content: the application of electrical power to the nuclear weapons and controller line replaceable units, and the monitor returns throughout the avionics system which determines weapon and delivery system status.

children.title: Signature blocks for responsible agency representatives.
System block diagram of the aircraft AMAC and release electrical systems.
Aircraft AMAC and release component descriptions.
Aircraft AMAC and release power source descriptions.
List of nuclear weapons to be used on AMAC interface.
List of ancillary test equipment to be used on AMAC interface.
List of training devices to be used on AMAC interface.
List of drawings that define the nuclear weapons, ancillary test equipment, and training devices appropriate to the aircraft.
